meaning: The suffix is attached to nouns, v. hæftníd-, mægenþrym-, wyndreám-ness; to adjectives, e. g. gód-, swít-, gífer-, nearu-ness; to numerals or pronouns, v. án-, hwilc-ness; to past participles, v. álífed-, gedréfed-ness; for-sewen-, ágoten-, gecoren-ness; to verbal roots, (l) weak : v. íc-, líf-, nere-, styre-ness. (2) strong: v. foreseó-, grów-, weax-ness. (3) pret. pres. wit-ness.
